data.name: Battle Charge
data.detailed_description:
Steam Greenlight


About the Game

Fifty against fifty. Every shield counts.

You are the hero in the line - not a general on a hill. Battle Charge is a third-person medieval tactical action-RPG where you lead a hero and a small army through cinematic skirmishes of about 50 vs 50. Charge. Break them. Then turn and hold the ground you just took.

Inspired by the battle scenes of Vikings, The Last Kingdom, Braveheart, and Barbarians. This is not high fantasy and not a strict historical sim. Bannerlord grit, Conqueror's Blade feel: readable chaos, not a thousand units you cannot see.

The shield wall is a weapon

Troops lock, brace, and react to charges. You give the order. Timing and pressure decide the fight - not button-mashing.

  • Push - grind the enemy back as one body.
  • Hold - brace for impact under a rain of arrows.

Charge. Then defend.

Each mission has an attack phase and a defense phase. Win the charge. Then hold against the next wave.

Plan the chaos: trap holes, a timed flaming-arrow ambush, a ballista strike that opens the line. Mixed troop types with different weapons and jobs. You pick the tactic for this battlefield.

A hero, loyal companions, a band of troops

Fight in third person with AI companions at your side. They are in the game now.

Co-op is in development. Friends dropping in as your companions is not in the current build. Wishlist for the single-player battles. We will say when co-op is actually playable - not before.

No giant armies. Just grit.

About 50 vs 50. Enough for a shield wall to matter. Small enough that a flank, a trap, or a bad hold can end the fight.

Wishlist Battle Charge

Windows. English. Coming soon. Add Battle Charge to your wishlist to get notified the moment it is available.

data.short_description: Lead a hero and a small army in cinematic ~50v50 medieval skirmishes. Command the shield wall to push or hold, set traps and ambushes, then charge the line and defend what you take. Third-person tactical action-RPG with AI companions, in a fictional Viking–knight world. Co-op still in development.
